post.text:
PixelOver試してみました 

やはりドット絵アニメーションの最先端はボーン操作なのか。フレーム補完した細かい差分まで作れますね https://t.co/UWtLK7svQT

一度設定さえ作ってしまえば、ボーンに使ってる画像を差し替えるだけで人間他キャラなら同じ動作が作れるので作業もだいぶ短縮できるはず

comments.name: Justen Moore
comments.text: @watari_toriyuki I actually use this for work it is great. A game I work on has an avatar the outfits can be changed so I just rigged up each piece and just make the set on an unanimated version then save each piece and open them on the rig and then save the animated pieces.

comments.name: Reda-OuーUltimate Villain ➥『 𝖘𝖔𝖚𝖙𝖍 𝖘𝖎𝖉𝖊 』
comments.text: @watari_toriyuki I'm really interested in this approach. I thought about rigging 3/4 (or at least not side-profile) sprites like this but I thought it would be difficult to get looking correct with more extreme poses. Does this work well for attack animations?
